note: Charges listed without a stated total (air freight, fuel and security; base and weight charge): the rules never add up lines, so the model transcribes them and code sums, one gateway call per such bid. Owner: Accuracy.
An airline answer that also names another lane's rate and transit time: two labelled transit times disagree, `bids._days` refuses and the model reads the bid. Owner: Accuracy.

An offer table with its currency only as '(€)' in the header: `bids.HEADER_CURRENCY` knows ISO codes only, so the total line has no currency and the model reads it (branch generalization/round-65-voice-offers reads the sign). Owner: Accuracy.
